window.name: Location
window._note: ETP-5806 housekeeping: this artifact was a pipeline orphan (AD Window 121 'Location', ISACTIVE='N', no menu entry, never processed through decisions.json/push-to-neo — only a stale March-2026 contract.json + generated/ from an early test run). Migrated into the pipeline now because its NEO Headless API stays live and writable (create/update/delete enabled) regardless of menu visibility, and a live MCP probe found it accepted plain-text addressLine1/addressLine2 writes with none of ETP-5806's structured-address rules applied — the one address-writing surface the rest of the ticket missed. PUSH_TO_NEO investigation (follow-up): populateWindowSpec/upsertEntity (schema_forge_core neo-writer.js) matches the existing ETGO_SF_ENTITY row by AD_Tab_ID, and the orphan row's ad_tab_id=154 correctly points at this window's real 'Location' tab (AD_Window_ID=121) — so push-to-neo UPDATEs that row in place, it never creates a duplicate. The real risk found was different: renameEntitiesToContractNames writes ETGO_SF_ENTITY.Name from the contract's entity key, which defaults to the tab-derived 'location' — that would have silently detached BpLocationHandler's `@NeoExtension(entity = "bpLocation")` binding (NeoExtensionIndex resolves purely on ETGO_SF_ENTITY.Name). Fixed by pinning `entities.location.name = "bpLocation"` below so the push keeps writing the name the handler expects. Now pushed to NEO (`make regen ONLY=bp-location PUSH_TO_NEO=1` + `./gradlew export.database`).

location.name: bpLocation
location._note: ETP-5806: must stay 'bpLocation' (not the auto-derived 'location') because BpLocationHandler.java declares @NeoExtension(spec = "bp-location", entity = "bpLocation") — NeoExtensionIndex resolves purely on ETGO_SF_ENTITY.Name, so letting push-to-neo rename the entity to the tab-derived 'location' would silently detach the handler (fallback to the qualifier path finds nothing, java_qualifier is intentionally null for this brand-new handler). javaQualifier is deliberately left unset here: this entity binds via @NeoExtension only, not @Named/ETGO_SF_ENTITY.Java_Qualifier.

addressLine1._note: ETP-5806: computed from streetName/buildingNumber/buildingName by BpLocationHandler, same algorithm (and same product decision: stricter than Classic) as ContactsLocationAddressHandler/WarehouseLocationHandler. Not yet pushed to NEO (ETGO_SF_FIELD.isreadonly stays 'N' live) — the handler enforces this by always overwriting the value server-side regardless of what a caller sends.

oBSEPAStreetName._note: ETP-5806 structured SEPA field, published as 'streetName' (see AddressVirtualSelectorPolicy#PUBLISHED_NAME_OVERRIDES and BpLocationHandler). Mandatory together with buildingNumber/cityName/country — enforced by BpLocationHandler, not by AD_Column.IsMandatory (still 'N' on EM_OBSEPA_StrtNm, so this 'required' flag is documentation only until a push-to-neo migration curates the live ETGO_SF_FIELD row).

oBSEPABuildingName._note: Published as 'buildingName'. Optional, matching every other ETP-5806 address surface.
